title: SAO Jack - SAO++ edition
credit: Original design: hamster, DEF CON 30 SAO Jack 1.0 (2022), MIT license, github.com/hamster/defcon30
notes: SAO++ power select: the switch common feeds the LEDs. Position 1 = badge 3.3 V, position 2 = OFF (pin 2 unconnected), position 3 = coin cell.
The badge supply and the coin cell sit on separate switch contacts and are never connected to each other.
LED-only board: SDA, SCL, GPIO1 and GPIO2 are not connected, so no series diode is needed on the cell (see docs/standard.md section 3).
KIT PARTS: R1, R2 and D1-D4 are through-hole and are soldered by the buyer, as on hamster's original. They are not in the assembly BOM.
As on the original, each resistor feeds two LEDs side by side: R1 the two left LEDs (D1, D3), R2 the two right LEDs (D2, D4), seen from the front.
Use the same colour for both LEDs of a pair: of two different colours on one resistor only the one that needs less voltage lights.
680 ohm (the maker used 100 ohm; his schematic says 140): about 1 mA per red, yellow or green LED on a 3.0 V cell or the badge's 3.3 V.
LED pad 1 (square hole) = cathode = short leg, toward the top of the board. LED lens on the front; resistor bodies on the back.
